message: 言霊

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya? I just heard a scream that sounded totally like a Demon's death throes--'Gyaaaaahhh--!?'--nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Over here, nya? Getting dragged into trouble would be a pain, so I'll sneak a peek, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Sneak, sneak, sneak...」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-W-Whaaat, nya!? Pasta's buddies are getting beaten to an absolute pulp, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「The culprits behind this mass slaughter are the Crusaders... nyahuh?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I recognize that idiot's face, nya. He's that broke comedian calling himself the Stoodent Council who was doing a married-couple comedy routine at Prier, nya」

name: Ardin
message: 「I see, so that bunch is the root of all evil!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaown!? Where'd you pop out from, nya?」

name: Ardin
message: 「That dark corner over there」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What are you planning to do if you drag Pasta into a dark corner, nya!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Were you stalking me again, nya!? Cut it out already, or I'm reporting you to Lord Virus-nya!」

name: Ardin
message: 「W-What's the big deal, what's the big deal! Virus this, Virus that! I'm way cooler than that bastard!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're totally uncool, nya」

name: Ardin
message: 「...Did you know, Pasta-chan? That bastard Virus stinks like sweat, y'know?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Lord Virus-nya is always in a state of heaven, nyan」

name: Pasta
message: 「Compared to him, both your body and breath reek like a beast, and a guy who talks trash behind someone's back has a rotten stink to his guts too, nya」

name: Ardin
message: 「G-Guhhh...」

name: Ardin
message: 「I'm cooler, and when I say I'm cooler, I mean it!!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Just watch me! I'm gonna beat those Crusaders black and blue and prove how cool I am!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I never asked you to do anything like that, nya!」

name: Ardin
message: 「W-When this battle is over, I'm gonna marry Pasta-chan」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's a textbook death flag, nyan」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whew~ Work's all done, so shall we head back, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. That story from earlier... How did it end up turning out?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh... I don't wanna hear it, but I wanna hear it...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean the rest of 'COME TO THE LEVEE AND GIVE ME FLOWERS'--'Come to the levee and give me flowers'?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Apparently, the students here have always been a bunch of softies」

name: Paqy
message: 「They held back their fear, pooled together what little pocket money they had, and bought flowers for a memorial」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then, they all went to the levee together and offered the flowers onto the water's surface」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that a nice story?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, happy endings are wonderful」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... How naive. It ain't over yet, y'know? The moment the flowers sank, eerie ripples spread across the water」

name: Paqy
message: 「'I FLOAT UP AND OBTAIN THE FLOWERS'--'I float up and obtain the flowers'--」

name: Ria
message: 「S-So it really does have a scary twist at the end...!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wait a second, Paqy-san, why does the sentence cut off in the middle? What comes after that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...You wanna know? Don't regret it later, hiss?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The final spirit―words are―」

name: Paqy
message: 「'CLEARING UP AT THE LEVEE, WHAT DO YOU HEAR'--'Clearing up at the levee, what do you hear'--」

name: Synn
message: 「W―What do you hea―」

name: Ardin
message: 「Yo, you bastards, prepare yourselves! My name is--」

name: Everyone
message: 「I-It appeared~~~?!」
